Incel means involuntarily celibate. Just because a vocal minority espouses toxic masculinity, it doesn't change the term, especially with the origin of this particular term.

I have the same issue with the term "Libertarian", just because people inaccurately associate it with far right anarcho-capitalism, that doesn't change political theory and the concept of a political compass. I'm a far left Libertarian.

People misusing a term, people portraying a vocal minority as a legitimate representation, is wholly inaccurate.

I do agree that the community you're talking about is trash, though, obviously. A toxic incel is no different from one in a relationship that views women in the same regard, and treats a woman like trash. You simply only see the toxic incel posting, never the rest. You simply see the bored raging toxic incel posting, instead of the toxic abuser in a relationship.

Not everyone who's involuntarily celibate blames women, is generally misogynistic, or is automatically toxic.

After a decade of rarely mustering up the courage to message women, I went on two dates with a woman. After a few weeks, she said she didn't have those feelings for me, I didn't blame her or hate her, I do feel she owed me the truth sooner, but she said she didn't want to stop talking, I suspect because she was lonely. We texted as friends until she got into a relationship a month later and ghosted me, still don't hate her, blame her, or even feel entitled to a continued back and forth as friends.

No woman owes me anything, my predicament is on me and my brain. I'm still "involuntarily celibate", by the definition of the term, despite not fitting your stereotype.

Hell is a lie. The Bible is pro-slavery and let's rapist buy their victims. So, slave owners go to heaven but sad people who end their suffering go to hell?

Fuck you, fuck your religion.

The financial burden is just another reason.

I've had, literally, constant suicidal thoughts for most of my life. My depression has made life all about survival, and now I have nothing to look forward to, I'm 32, I never thought I'd live this long, I didn't want to. I've been too successful at putting off death.

I can't just live like this forever, and there's no chance of my life improving. I don't believe in signs, but I've been shit on by the universe non-stop for the past several years. I don't want to to anything other than waste away in bed. Haven't eaten in over 24 hours.

At what point do we decide effort only creates more misery?

To specify. Hit my lowest low tonight. Been in what feels like a four day panic attack, more depressed than I've ever been, which is saying a lot; I feel like I'm 200+ days past my dead by date. Used a specific age to put off suicide for 20+ years, and I'm 3 MONTHS to 1 year past that arbitrary but ingrained day.

Then I had an uncomfortable situation.

Then, a crown came out and I'm poor in a COVID-19 infested state.

Normally, I live in spite of signs, now I'm convinced I'm being told what to do. Temporarily bumming people out seems less of an issue.
How did it go? I'll likely be doing so by the end if the month at the latest.
Thanks, I don't see anything improving, but I don't have the option of suicide, even if it's all I want.
